Price varies by exhibition. Same-day adult (一般) ticket for the current exhibition, Fontanesi (17 Oct 2026 to 24 Jan 2027), is 2,300 yen tax included. Advance online ticket was 2,100 yen, sold until 16 Oct. The cheapest option is no longer available.
Cheapest adult option is the web ticket at 2,500 yen tax included, and same-day web purchase is also possible. The same-day ticket machine price is 2,700 yen.
Price varies by exhibition. General adult (一般) admission for the current exhibition, Nikolaj Astrup: Creating Garden, is 1,800 yen.
